subject: APAC/EU/US demo — backfill plan for Golden Week + Diwali overlap
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@lightgrid.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T15:08:00-05:00
Subject: Request: demo reschedule — Golden Week + Diwali overlap

Hi Sofia / Ben,

Quick context: our engineering and product teams in APAC will be mostly OOO for Golden Week (Japan) the week of Nov 23, and a separate subset of India-based folks will be off for Diwali on Nov 24–26. We originally planned the full product walkthrough across APAC/EU/US on Nov 24 which now conflicts with both windows.

Can we shift the full-demo or run a backfill plan so we don't block our internal stakeholders? Preferably we'd like at least one live session that includes APAC engineering and a second recording + short live Q&A timed for EU/US.

Also attaching our security questionnaire the buyer team requested — security folks may have follow-ups.

Cheers,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Integrations, Lightgrid AI
maya@lightgrid.ai

Attachment: Lightgrid_Security_QA.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@lightgrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: demo reschedule — Golden Week + Diwali overlap

Thanks for the heads-up, Maya — totally understand the overlap pain. We can absolutely avoid forcing a single time that excludes key teams. Proposed plan below (quick bullets so we can action):

- Live APAC-friendly slot (shorter deep-dive): Nov 22 09:00 JST / Nov 21 17:00 UTC — 45 minutes focused on infra, KV cache, and private deployment Qs.
- Recorded full walkthrough (90m deck + demo) to be posted by Nov 23 EOD; we’ll follow with two 30-minute live Q&A windows for EU and US.
- EU live Q&A: Nov 24 14:00 CET (45 minutes) — product + CS.
- US live Q&A: Nov 24 16:30 PT (45 minutes) — sales + engineer.
- For Diwali days (Nov 24–26): we won’t expect APAC attendance; recordings + asynchronous notes will be treated as first-class.

Operational guardrails we suggest to preserve SLOs and customer experience:
- Label the recorded walkthrough with timestamps and a short TL;DR (so engineers can jump to infra sections).
- Provide a short “backfill packet” (2 slide summary + 15m highlight video) so folks who only watch asynchronously get the high-level decisions.
- Offer one-on-one 30m office hours during the following week for deep technical questions (bookable links to follow).

Ben / Marcus — can you confirm seat for the APAC slot if we proceed Nov 22 morning JST? I’ll draft invites and the recording plan once we align.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf, 28KB)

Sounds good to me — I can cover the sales intro + license/SLAs for the APAC slot on Nov 22 JST. Two quick asks:

1) We should run a 20–30 minute canary session for the recording to validate streaming/recording quality and ensure any internal access tokens are scrubbed.
2) Can we include a 5-minute slide about routing/fallback behavior (region failover) — that's been a procurement question lately.

I’ll hold Nov 22 on my calendar pending final confirmation from Sofia + Maya.

— Ben
